description: Files a feature request on the public board and upvotes it for you. Use it when the human wishes the API did something it cannot (a boundary type, export format, op or option). It first looks for similar requests: if any match it files nothing and returns them in `similar`, so you can upvote_feedback the right one; pass force: true to file anyway. Free; needs a key; 10 new items per account a day. The human gets a thank-you email and an email on every status change. Feature requests are public (never the author's email); issues are private to you and the team. Do not include API keys, personal data or customer data. Needs an API key or a connected account.

details.description: Why you need it and what you are building; concrete examples help it get planned.

force.description: File even when similar requests exist.

title.description: What you want, in one line.
